changelog:
- Initial release of qdrant-advisor skill.
- Enables diagnosis and troubleshooting for any Qdrant deployment using live, authoritative skills from skills.qdrant.tech.
- Guides users through issue framing, hierarchical skill lookups, and step-wise problem resolution for symptoms like slow queries, memory issues, crashes, and scaling.
- Prioritizes up-to-date, context-loaded guidance over memory-based responses.
- Supports a broad range of concerns: search performance, optimizer and index issues, scaling, setup, deployment models, SDK usage, and more.
- Emphasizes actionable steps, ordered diagnostics, cautionary notes, and relevant documentation links for further reference.
summary: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and advise on any Qdrant deployment by loading the latest official Qdrant skills live from skills.qdrant.tech. Use this whenever someone raises a Qdrant problem or question — slow or degraded search, high or growing memory / OOM crashes, optimizer stuck or slow, indexing slow
